evidence: Every non-trivial task requires: Research receipt -> Plan receipt -> Execution receipt -> Verifier receipt -> Archive receipt. Each phase reads the prior phase's receipt before proceeding. Skip requires collapse_eligible: true in recipe.json plus complexity below threshold. Implied completion prohibited (I10). Guard enforces the chain via required_receipts in session/state.json. Missing receipt in chain triggers DEPENDENCY error. Archive aggregates all receipts into delivery receipt. Receipt files written to .wabblespec/receipts/ with timestamp in filename.
